contract: Client feed and share lifecycle. This record covers the feed half: open and close from the item, collection and series RSS modals and unauthenticated feed-reader consumption of the XML, cover and enclosure. The share half (share open/close and the public share consumer routes) is proven by the share packet records route-r195, route-r196 and route-r220 to route-r224.

invariants.contract: The web client's feed journey open -> read -> close: the OpenCloseModal POST for an item, collection or series persists a feed with the requested slug and metadata details, GET /api/feeds lists it immediately, POST /api/feeds/:id/close deletes the feed and its feed episodes so the list no longer contains it and its public XML, cover and enclosure answer 404, and a failed open (item without audio tracks, unknown entity, used slug) answers 4xx, persists nothing and leaves no readable feed for the requested slug.

An unauthenticated feed reader consumes the same URLs the XML advertises: GET /feed/:slug returns the RSS document, the image URL it advertises serves the cover bytes and the enclosure URL serves the episode file with byte-range support. After the item's title changes the next fetch returns the new title with the same GUID and enclosure URL; after the feed is closed every one of those URLs answers 404 while the media file and the library item row stay intact.

exceptions: force is not applicable: no feed route or feed consumer has a force, hard or override mode; refresh happens implicitly when the source entity is newer than entityUpdatedAt.
The share half of this requirement is proven by the share packet records route-r195/r196/r220-r224; this packet's write set cannot assert share routes.
Error bodies are asserted by status only; the web modal shows error.response.data as a toast but parses nothing (OpenCloseModal.vue:152-156).
Feed list array order is not asserted (only that feeds[] and minified[] are index-aligned); the config page maps and re-sorts episodes by pubDate (client/pages/config/rss-feeds.vue:140-146).
